notes.title: Chosen of God Receives a Major Update
notes.content:
Chosen of God Receives a Major Update!
We've added a series of key features to enrich your experience in Chosen of God:

Parry: A new defensive mechanic for more tactical combat.
Inventory and Loot System: Collect and manage items with different rarity levels (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary).
Item Management: Sell or upgrade your items to power up your character.
Character Progression: Level up and customize your hero by assigning points to Vitality, Endurance, Damage, and Dextery.
Optimized Controls: Smoother and more precise navigation with controllers.
Improved Slingshot: The slingshot's VFX is now much cooler.
